crossRefs.note: Kiriath Baal (also called Kiriath Jearim), and Rabbah; two cities with their villages.
The men of Kiriath Jearim came and took Yahweh’s ark, and brought it into Abinadab’s house on the hill, and consecrated…
So David assembled all Israel together, from the Shihor the brook of Egypt even to the entrance of Hamath, to bring…
David went up with all Israel to Baalah, that is, to Kiriath Jearim, which belonged to Judah, to bring up from there…
But David had brought God’s ark up from Kiriath Jearim to the place that David had prepared for it; for he had pitched…
Yahweh’s Spirit began to move him in Mahaneh Dan, between Zorah and Eshtaol.

people.name: Kiriath-jearim
people.line: A city where the ark resided

people.name: Mahaneh-dan
people.line: A place between Zorah and Eshtaol; Samson's birthplace

translations.web: They went up and encamped in Kiriath Jearim in Judah. Therefore they call that place Mahaneh Dan to this day. Behold, it is behind Kiriath Jearim.
translations.bsb: They went up and camped at Kiriath-jearim in Judah. That is why the place west of Kiriath-jearim is called Mahaneh-dan to this day.
translations.kjv: And they went up, and pitched in Kirjathjearim, in Judah: wherefore they called that place Mahanehdan unto this day: behold, it is behind Kirjathjearim.
translations.asv: And they went up, and encamped in Kiriath-jearim, in Judah: wherefore they called that place Mahaneh-dan, unto this day; behold, it is behind Kiriath-jearim.
